sourceIdentity.meaning: The actual canary execution head has the same 9 critical source blobs as the accepted Worker source; the canary API report does not independently expose the live Worker deployment ID.

cleanupInterpretation.evidence: Successful workflow cleanup step and cleanupVerified report flag require zero reserved user roots, empty PRAGMA foreign_key_check, and positive cascade count.

closure.reason: Existing successful same-source Worker preflight reports predate cleanup. Scope closes with reserved root zero, clean FK integrity and positive cascade changes, without an additional production validation loop.

initialAttempt.failure: Two recovery cases reached their business assertions but failed strict zero-page-error checks because auth/session and pageview were not mocked. A targeted fixture repair preserves all strict assertions; its canonical rerun is pending.

sourceIdentity.proof: Both commits have identical .github, scripts, src and tests tree SHAs; the nine leaf blobs were read from those identical Git trees.
